foreign-exchange-market-mirror.alt: Two foreign exchange graphs side by side. Left: the market for euros, with Quantity of euros on the horizontal axis and Price of the euro (dollars per euro) on the vertical axis, a downward demand curve and an upward supply curve crossing at E1, with exchange rate XR1 and quantity Q1. Right: the market for dollars, with Quantity of dollars and Price of the dollar (euros per dollar). Notes: demand for euros comes from people buying European goods, services and assets; supply of euros from Europeans buying American ones; more demand for euros is the same trades as more supply of dollars.
